issues.rationale: Quarantine acquired the advisory lock before the profile row lock while normal profile updates acquired them in the opposite order, allowing a deadlock to abort the compensation path.
issues.fix: Acquire the profile row lock before the per-user advisory lock in quarantine and add a deterministic two-connection crossing regression.
issues.disposition_reason: Quarantine now follows the profile-row then advisory-lock order. The competing profile update fails at the guard, quarantine records update_unknown and deactivates the profile, and PostgreSQL reports no deadlock.

issues.rationale: The initial claim lookup excluded already claimed rows, so a request arriving after the first claim committed returned invalid instead of busy and cleared the browser Cookie.
issues.fix: Resolve the user from any active unexpired token, then distinguish claimed, busy, and invalid under the per-user lock.
issues.disposition_reason: The initial lookup no longer filters claim_id. Both concurrent and committed duplicate claims return busy, while release allows a later claim and finalize. Integration and concurrency regressions passed.
